principles: Fix only the observed correctness issue
Keep DONE historical evidence read-only and non-authority
drivers: Already-DONE stories should not be retroactively marked stale because main moved later
TEST stories must still detect stale evidence
done_closure is a projection, not a repair command

options.name: A: For phase DONE, compare evidence materialHash against evidence.headHash material tree
cons: Requires a targeted code path for DONE stories

options.name: B: Exclude all story metadata from currentMaterialHash only
cons: Does not solve later unrelated material commits after DONE

options.name: C: Treat evidence-freshness as warning for all stories
cons: Weakens active TEST/DONE gates and risks stale evidence entering DONE

chosen: A: For phase DONE, compare evidence materialHash against evidence.headHash material tree
rationale: Choose A because the bug is historical DONE projection only; active stories must continue to compare against current material state. A fixes the real inconsistency without arbitrary gate weakening.

preMortem.scenario: Active TEST stories stop blocking stale material changes
preMortem.trigger: DONE-specific code path accidentally applies to non-DONE phases
preMortem.mitigation: Branch on story.phase === DONE only and add regression that active TEST still fails after material change

preMortem.trigger: Old commit pruned or shallow clone
preMortem.consequence: DONE projection cannot verify historical snapshot
preMortem.mitigation: Fail closed or fall back to existing check when recorded ref material hash cannot be computed

preMortem.trigger: DONE projection pass is misread as Authority proof
preMortem.consequence: Local DONE is confused with receipt-backed completion
preMortem.mitigation: Do not touch Authority path; preserve done_closure authorityServerPath receiptVerified=false unless receipts exist
